title: Pragmatic Porkers
description: This datapack modifies pigs to drop bones when killed, at the same frequency with which cows drop leather.
body:
This datapack modifies pigs to drop bones when killed, at the same frequency with which cows drop leather.

UPDATE!!!

I just found out that this datapack is not compatible with Farmer's Delight. Pragmatic Porkers replaces the pig loot tables after FD edits them, so no more ham being dropped. :( As long as you're not playing with FD or any other mod that edits pig drops, it should still be okay.
